The ASV recasts the purpose infinitive as a coordinated finite clause and states nothing of the preposition's own relation, so the le is unrepresented (rule 40). Rule 52 places a word written in that slot only where it is a complementizer or an ordinary preposition; a preposition whose relation the ASV has left unstated is not a home for a coordinator (rule 14).

No conjunction morpheme stands in this clause, so the coordinating and answers to nothing and is its own added unit (rules 14 and 30). It is not folded into the preposition, the verb or the noun beside it, for the reason rule 42 gives about a surplus and. The verse's other unrendered conjunction, s031, stands in the apodosis, which the ASV opens bare, so this and is not its reordered rendering either.

review_notes: Corrected: the and written where the purpose le stands (t033) is now its own added unit and the le is unrepresented. Rule 14's closing sentences are explicit that a coordinating and for a clause in which no conjunction morpheme stands is added, and that a preposition whose own relation the ASV has left unstated is unrepresented under rule 40 rather than a home for a coordinator; rule 52 reaches a complementizer or an ordinary preposition written in that slot, not a clause coordinator.
The competing reading, which the previous alignment took, gave that and to the le under rule 52's read that as no word, not as no complementizer; it is recorded here and set aside.

The apodosis waw s031 stays unrepresented: the ASV opens all the city cried out bare, so t033 is not its reordered connective either; the verse's four conjunctions against three written connectives leave one waw and the le unrendered.
Variant WLC.1SA.4.13.v001 resolved to r00-base, which supplies s010; the projection is aligned as it stands (rule 9).
yad derekh is retained as one unit: wayside writes both lexemes, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is met and rule 23 heads it on the governing construct.
haya (s014) is left unrepresented: the ASV writes only the finite trembled for the predicate adjective, and the two morphemes are not contiguous, so rule 30 does not fuse them.
